description: When does a domain expire? Registration expiry and registrar via RDAP. $0.01 USDC on Base per call. Returns registrar, registration and expiry dates, days left, EPP status and nameservers. Within 60 days of expiry, fixes[] gives auto-renew steps for the registrar. Don't use this for SSL certificate expiry; use /v1/cert. [x402: pays from the caller's wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY); without a key the tool returns the live 402 price only.]
name: orioncmd_expiry
title: OrionCMD Checks: GET /v1/expiry
